title: 数量、比例与变化

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

questions.prompt: There are ____ participants in the small group.
questions.evidence: There are a few participants in the small group.
questions.explanation: participants 是复数可数名词，用 a few。

questions.prompt: There is ____ information in the note.
questions.evidence: There is a little information in the note.
questions.explanation: information 不可数，用 a little。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about countable people.
questions.explanation: 居民人数是可数数量，用 how many。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about uncountable information.
questions.explanation: information 不可数，用 how much 和 is。

questions.prompt: Twelve out of twenty respondents is ____ percent.
questions.evidence: Twelve out of twenty respondents is 60 percent.

questions.prompt: Twenty out of twenty-five invited people is ____ percent.
questions.evidence: Twenty out of twenty-five invited people is 80 percent.

questions.prompt: Five out of twenty is one ____.
questions.evidence: Five out of twenty is one quarter.

questions.prompt: Ten out of twenty is one ____.
questions.evidence: Ten out of twenty is one half.

questions.prompt: In the records for last month and this month, the library count ____ from four to nine.
questions.evidence: 比较两次已记录的数量时，可用过去式 increased / decreased 或表达 remain stable；描述现在图表也可用一般现在时。
questions.explanation: 描述两次已记录的变化，使用过去式 increased。

questions.prompt: In the two recorded classes, the plant count ____ at six.
questions.evidence: 比较两次已记录的数量时，可用过去式 increased / decreased 或表达 remain stable；描述现在图表也可用一般现在时。
questions.explanation: 两次记录均为六，使用过去式 remained。

questions.prompt: A count rose from three to seven. Choose the correct description.
options: The count increased from seven to three.
The count decreased from three to seven.
The count increased from three to seven.
answers: The count increased from three to seven.
questions.evidence: 比较两次已记录的数量时，可用过去式 increased / decreased 或表达 remain stable；描述现在图表也可用一般现在时。
questions.explanation: 三升到七，用 increased from three to seven。

questions.prompt: In two rounds, five people chose benches first and nine chose benches next. Which statement follows from those counts alone?
options: The number choosing benches rose from five to nine.
The number will rise every year.
answers: The number choosing benches rose from five to nine.
questions.evidence: 两点变化本身不证明长期趋势。
questions.explanation: 已知两次选择数由五增至九，不能由此确定长期趋势或全镇意见。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations. Questions 1–8 are guided practice; questions 9–12 use the rules in new contexts.
passage:
1. 数量词要与名词一致：many / a few 修饰复数可数名词，much / a little 修饰不可数名词。数字前后也要明确单位和被统计的对象。
例句：There are a few participants in the small group. There is a little information in the note. How many residents replied? How much information is available?

2. percent 表示每百份中的多少，比例计算必须说明分母：20 out of 25 是受邀者的80%，12 out of 20 是答复者的60%。half 表示二分之一，a quarter 表示四分之一。
例句：Twelve out of twenty respondents is 60 percent. Twenty out of twenty-five invited people is 80 percent. Five out of twenty is one quarter. Ten out of twenty is one half.

3. 比较两次已记录的数量时，可用过去式 increased / decreased 或表达 remain stable；描述现在图表也可用一般现在时。两点变化本身不证明长期趋势。
例句：The library count increased from three to five. Visitor numbers remained at ten.
